name: singlet_perturbation_unseen_gene_response_prediction
title: Unseen single-gene perturbation response prediction
description: Predicts the pseudobulk expression change for held-out single-gene perturbations that have no training data, from control cells and measured responses to other genes. Default is a ridge bilinear model on training-data gene embeddings; training_mean is the perturbation-agnostic comparator and gears is a graph neural network. Writes uns/pert_pred_mean, with intervals for bilinear_ridge, and scores against measured profiles when they exist. Do not use for combinatorial, chemical or compound perturbations, or to predict single-cell distributions.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Layer to pseudobulk; cells are size-factor normalised and log1p transformed before averaging.

method.description: Prediction method; training_mean is the perturbation-agnostic comparator.

targets.description: Held-out perturbation labels to predict; excluded from training. Labels with measured profiles are also scored.

control_label.description: Value of obs/perturbation that marks control cells.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for gears training; the linear methods are deterministic given their inputs.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

pca_dim.description: Dimension of training-data PCA gene and perturbation embeddings.

ridge_penalty.description: Ridge penalty applied on both sides of the bilinear solve.

gene_embedding.description: training_data, or a path to an external gene embedding table.

interval_level.description: Posterior predictive interval level; 0 disables intervals.

hidden_size.description: Hidden dimension of gene and perturbation embeddings.

coexpress_threshold.description: Correlation threshold for the co-expression graph.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/pert_pred_mean. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_targets, n_scored, mean_r_delta, mean_pearson, mean_l2, baseline_mean_r_delta. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
